caveats: The flow, the RTL and the EXT bench were not yet committed when the runs were made; inputs.sha256 fingerprints them, and the record is filed under bd800d8, the commit they are based on.

The full run took 45 min 07 s against 26 min 18 s for the record of c1a7c85: the EXT mutation campaign has 1,702 runs instead of 493, and the monolithic H6 proof by bitwuzla (hint_validity_h6_bwn 1,698.8 s, h6_bw 825.9 s) ran alongside it.
The usage comment at the top of formal/run.sh still gives the times of the record of c1a7c85 (about 1.5 min for default, 25-35 min for full, about 30 s for ext); no executed line differs.
Wall times depend on the host and its load and are never compared.

What is and is not proven: formal/README.md section 5 (item 9 for the EXT unit: the decoder's map from instruction word to payload, payloads the decoder never builds, including the reserved codes of the cryptography half, and everything downstream of Execute are outside the proof).
